responsibility: Declares the StrLib API for core fixed-array string manipulation routines such as concatenation, comparison, equality testing, length calculation, bounded copy, substring search, and trimming of leading whitespace. It is the public interface for low-level character-array utilities, distinct from DynamicStrings’ managed-string abstraction.
same_name_distinction: This header differs from GStrLib.cc by serving solely as the API surface for low-level fixed-array string helpers. It does not contain the concrete buffer-processing algorithms, local copies of open arrays, or whitespace-test helper used in the .cc implementation.
